plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Session or event correlation id, for tracing user/context lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time the recommendation signal/event was logged.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this signal record (for corrections, feedback propagation, etc).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_ai_personalization_profiles
models.description: Per-user AI personalization/segmentation profile. Maintains long-lived, explainable analytics about user's preferences, affinity vectors/features, cluster/segment assignment, opt-outs, and important model explainability factors. Updated on profile-triggering events and batch AI processing. Enables highly targeted experiences, responsible AI, and rollbacks.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}. References the subject of the profile.

plainFields.name: profile_type
plainFields.description: Type of profile (e.g., 'profile_v1', 'segment_v2', 'contextual', etc.).

plainFields.name: affinity_vector
plainFields.description: AI-generated vector or JSON summary of user preferences/features (stringified for flexibility).

plainFields.name: segment_label
plainFields.description: Current segment or group assigned by AI (e.g., 'fashion_enthusiast', 'tech_buyer').

plainFields.name: exclusions
plainFields.description: Serialized exclusions (brands, categories) opted out of personalization.

plainFields.name: explainability_json
plainFields.description: Explainability/interpretability model results in JSON.

plainFields.name: last_update_source
plainFields.description: What triggered the last update (event type, batch, admin).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Latest profile update time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Profile creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_ai_analytics_exposures
models.description: Tracks analytic/experiment/feature exposure events, logging who/what was shown, group/variant, context, exposure metadata (e.g., AI campaign, test, or algorithm). Critical for A/B test analysis, campaign attribution, model governance and privacy log requirements. Supports business/statistical analytics and audit.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}. References exposed subject for analytics.

plainFields.name: exposure_type
plainFields.description: Nature of exposure (e.g., 'AI_campaign', 'ab_test', 'recommendation_algo').

plainFields.name: exposure_context
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON context of exposure (e.g., what was shown, parameters, features).

plainFields.name: group_assignment
plainFields.description: Variant or group id for bucket analysis ('A', 'B', 'control', etc.).

plainFields.name: exposure_metadata
plainFields.description: Any additional metadata re: exposure type, test conditions, etc. (JSON).

plainFields.name: result_outcome
plainFields.description: Post-exposure response or outcome, for effect attribution. (e.g., click, conversion, bounce).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the exposure occurred/logged.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_ai_price_optimizations
models.description: Records of all AI-driven (or heuristic) price optimization events, such as suggestions, updates, campaign-triggered changes, and final acceptance. Linked to time, product, channel, suggestion metadata, and campaign context. Stores rationale, output, acceptance by operators, and actual result (if known). Enables pricing science, campaign and model tuning analytics, regulatory/compliance evidence.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Targeted product's {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}. References the product for which a price optimization event occurred.

plainFields.name: optimization_type
plainFields.description: Type/purpose of price optimization (e.g., 'AI_suggestion', 'manual_intervention', 'campaign', 'regulatory_correction').

plainFields.name: channel_id
plainFields.description: Channel/store/campaign context in which the optimization was performed (if multi-channel).

plainFields.name: original_price
plainFields.description: Original product price before optimization event.

plainFields.name: suggested_price
plainFields.description: Price suggested by AI/model/campaign, etc.

plainFields.name: final_price
plainFields.description: Final price actually applied (may differ from suggestion).

plainFields.name: decision_rationale
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON documenting explanation/justification (regulatory, model, business) for optimization.

plainFields.name: accepted_by
plainFields.description: Who/what accepted the suggestion (user id, automated, override, etc.).

plainFields.name: result_outcome
plainFields.description: Final observed result/impact (if measured) - e.g., conversion uplift, inventory move, complaint, rollback.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of price optimization event.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp last updated (correction, outcome update, etc.).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_fraud_logs
models.description: Specialized event/incident log capturing AI/heuristics-driven fraud/risk scoring, intervention triggers (e.g., high-risk behaviors, payment anomalies), and final actions (blocks, holds, escalations). Each row records all primary signal properties, reasoning, action, and business outcome. Used for risk analytics, compliance, fraud audits, and tuning of AI risk models.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Optional involved customer's {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order context (if relevant): {@link shopping_mall_ai_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: fraud_signal_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of fraud/risk indicator (e.g., 'multi_failed_login', 'stolen_card', 'geolocation_mismatch', etc.).

plainFields.name: risk_score
plainFields.description: Quantitative fraud/risk score produced by AI/model/heuristic analysis.

plainFields.name: detail_json
plainFields.description: JSON-serialized input/behavior/data (IP, device, location, context, etc) for root cause/evidence.

plainFields.name: intervention_type
plainFields.description: Action taken due to risk/fraud (e.g., 'soft_block', 'order_hold', 'user_alert', 'system_lock', etc.)

plainFields.name: final_outcome
plainFields.description: Result of fraud incident investigation (e.g., 'auto_resolved', 'escalated', 'cleared', 'blocked').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of fraud detection/incident logged.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_incident_logs
models.description: Business-level, centralized incident log for exceptions, anomalies, business rule violations, workflow failures, errors, or escalated security/AI/fraud events not captured in domain-specific logs. Includes context, trigger source, actors, impact, timeline, affected objects, timeline/status, and resolution. Key for regulatory, operational, and cross-domain audit/compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Associated customer if relevant. Optional link to {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: incident_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of incident (e.g., 'AI_runtime_error', 'workflow_failure', 'policy_violation', 'escalated_support', 'security_flag', etc).

plainFields.name: incident_context
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON context and trigger snapshot.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of incident resolution (e.g., 'open', 'in_review', 'escalated', 'resolved', 'closed').

plainFields.name: impact_level
plainFields.description: Freeform impact classification (e.g., 'none', 'minor', 'business', 'data_loss', 'legal', etc).

plainFields.name: actor
plainFields.description: Who/what triggered or is responsible for the incident (user id, system, AI, admin, etc).

plainFields.name: resolution_summary
plainFields.description: Description/summary of resolution, mitigation, or update.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the incident was logged/created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this incident record was last updated (status, resolution).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_audit_trails
models.description: Long-term, full-fidelity audit log for all AI-driven and business-critical actions/decisions/changes affecting major business objects (user, product, order, payment, model, pricing, access, etc). Immutable, actor/timestamp/event/target cross-referenced. Essential for compliance, root-cause, incident investigation, and regulatory/legal discovery.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Subject/affected customer, if any. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of audit event (e.g., 'ai_action', 'data_edit', 'access_grant', 'fraud_flag', 'model_update').

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: What was affected by this event (e.g., 'product', 'order', 'user', 'model', 'pricing').

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Business identifier (UUID or business id) of the affected object.

plainFields.name: actor
plainFields.description: Who/what performed/triggered this action (user id, system, admin, AI).

plainFields.name: data_before
plainFields.description: Serialized (JSON) snapshot of object state before change/event, or null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: data_after
plainFields.description: Serialized (JSON) snapshot of object state after change/event, or null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Free-form business explanation of what happened, why (for compliance).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit event timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_sections
models.description: Master table for all store sections/sub-stores within the platform. Represents logical or branded subdivisions of the shopping mall, organizing products and categories per business, brand, or special segment. Critical for multi-store environments, this model establishes the backbone for product and category mapping, as well as for access control and customization. Related to {@link shopping_mall_ai_channels} and {@link shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories} via foreign keys or mappings.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the section/sub-store (e.g., 'Fashion Plaza', 'Brand X Outlet').

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business-unique, immutable code identifier for the section (e.g., 'FASHION_PLAZA'). Used for administration, mapping, and reference in other tables. Must be unique across all sections.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description and business purpose of the section. Used for administration and display. Optional for some sections.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this section is currently enabled and visible to platform users. Controls store appearance and admin access.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort/display priority for front-end listing and backoffice UI. Lower values show earlier; ties broken by name.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of section creation (for auditing and lifecycle management).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to section data.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was (soft) deleted; nullable for active records.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_channels
models.description: Master table for business channels (sales, affiliate, event, or brand-specific), forming top-level logical groupings for catalog and transaction flows. Channels define eligibility, business rules, region, or promotional context (e.g., 'Main', 'Mobile', 'Partner_A'). Many platform processes and products are mapped per channel. Related to {@link shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories} and {@link shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_maps}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Business display name of the channel. Typically used by frontend and admin. Examples: 'Main Channel', 'Mobile Exclusive'.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique channel code. Immutable, used for business process mapping (e.g., 'MAIN', 'MOBILE', 'PARTNER_A').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form description or notes for the channel's business scope, restrictions, or target audience.

plainFields.name: region_code
plainFields.description: Optional code for regional segmentation or country grouping (e.g., 'KR', 'US', 'ASIA'). Null if global.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this channel is currently active and available for operations, mapping, or display.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order in which the channel appears on lists or in backoffice config; lower values have higher priority.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of channel creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this channel/model.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp if channel is removed from platform offering.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories
models.description: Master table for categories which exist within the context of a particular sales channel. Enables per-channel category definitions, business policies, and display layouts. This decouples global categories from channel-specific ones, allowing for localized or customized category trees. Used throughout admin and front system for navigation, search, and product mapping. Mapped via {@link shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_maps}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Parent channel's {@link shopping_mall_ai_channels.id}. Category only visible in this channel context.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-friendly display name for the category as presented in this channel context.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code for this category in the channel context. Used for mapping, lookup, and business rules.

plainFields.name: parent_id
plainFields.description: (Nullable) Self-reference for hierarchical category trees. Null if root. Points to {@link shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort/display priority in category trees/tabs/menus within a channel. Lower = higher up.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional long-form text describing the category, policy, or intended product domain.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this category is active in platform navigation and product assignment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for tracking and audit.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for data lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion marker for business-side purging or audit only.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_maps
models.description: Junction table mapping channel-specific categories to global categories in the system (which exist in another component as shopping_mall_ai_categories). This enables complex mapping of platform-, channel-, or locale-level category trees, while maintaining independence from global changes. Maintains referential integrity to both local (channel category) and global category models. Used heavily in admin mapping workflows and in search/category navigation. No business fields—purely mapping.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_id
foreignFields.description: Target channel category's {@link shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_category_id
foreignFields.description: Target global category's {@link shopping_mall_ai_categories.id} (external component - foreign reference only).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this mapping (for auditing/ref, not for business display).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_configurations
models.description: System-level configuration and master option codes table. Stores key-value pairs and hierarchical configuration settings for cross-domain control. Used for toggles (e.g., feature flags), system-wide limits, business rules, or display texts. Central authority for all reference options (not business domain data). Keys are unique per component-scope (e.g., SYSTEM, PRODUCT, ORDER).

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Type or functional domain of the configuration (e.g., 'SYSTEM', 'PRODUCT', 'ORDER', 'CHANNEL', application area, etc.). Used for grouping config sets and enforcing option scoping. Must be indexed for fast scoping lookup.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Config option code (e.g., 'DEFAULT_CURRENCY', 'INVITE_ENABLED'). Unique per scope. Drives feature flags, master data, or parameter assignment.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: String-encoded configuration value. Holds the effective parameter, toggle, or default for the option context. Decoded by services/UI per config key type.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the configuration item—business logic, impact, range of values, or operational notes.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this option is currently active. Used to phase in/out major config elements or setup automated rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for config/audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp in config lifecycle.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if config is logically removed from live scope.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_customers
models.description: Represents individual customers registered on the shoppingMallAi platform. This model tracks customer-specific credentials, contact information, verification status, authentication details, and account lifecycle (active, suspended, withdrawn). It supports the full customer registration, authentication, profile management, and permission enforcement lifecycle. Directly subject to strict business and legal compliance for identity information. No overlap with seller or administrator information.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address. Used for login, notification, and unique identity enforcement. Must be unique among all customers and verified during registration. Business rule: cannot be null.

plainFields.name: mobile
plainFields.description: Customer's mobile phone number. Used for account recovery, 2FA, and notifications. May be required for certain operations. Business rule: optional in registration, but required for some features.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt or Argon2 encoded password hash for authentication. Only for internal login; not set for OAuth/SSO-only accounts. Never exposed to client applications.

plainFields.name: oauth_provider
plainFields.description: OAuth or SSO provider identifier if registered via external login. Null for local/password accounts.

plainFields.name: provider_account_id
plainFields.description: External provider's account ID, if any. Null for password-auth accounts.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Customer display nickname or handle. May be changed by user subject to business rules and length/policy constraints.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the customer's email is verified. Used to determine eligibility for most actions beyond browsing.

plainFields.name: is_mobile_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the customer's mobile is verified. Required for certain business actions.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Customer account status. Enum: 'active', 'pending', 'suspended', 'withdrawn', 'banned'. Business logic controls access per status.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Last successful login timestamp for session and security tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was logically deleted (withdrawn). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_sellers
models.description: Represents business sellers on the shoppingMallAi platform. Tracks seller credentials, business registration, account lifecycle, and verification status. Only unique to sellers, disjoint from customers/administrators. Includes identity, contact, compliance, and verification workflow management. Every seller must be approved by an administrator prior to making transactions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's email address. Used for login, notifications, and identity. Must be unique among sellers.

plainFields.name: mobile
plainFields.description: Seller's mobile or business contact number. Used for authentication/notification. Optional on initial application, may be required for further business actions.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public display name of the seller's business/channel. May differ from internal legal name.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for login (BCrypt/Argon2). Not set if only using OAuth/SSO.

plainFields.name: oauth_provider
plainFields.description: OAuth or SSO provider name, if registered externally. Null for password-based.

plainFields.name: provider_account_id
plainFields.description: Provider-side identity value, if OAuth/SSO is used.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal company or business name registered for compliance/audit. Required for verification.

plainFields.name: business_registration_number
plainFields.description: Official business registration ID as required by law. Must be unique among all sellers.

plainFields.name: bank_account_number
plainFields.description: Seller's designated bank account for settlements and remittances. May be required only after verification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Seller account status. Enum: 'active', 'pending', 'suspended', 'withdrawn', 'banned'. Controls permissions/business actions.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the seller has passed admin/kyc verification and is permitted to transact.

plainFields.name: verification_requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller requested verification. Aids in SLA enforcement.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when verification completed. Null until verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller account last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller withdrew or was removed. Null if account is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_administrators
models.description: Platform superusers and operators with system-wide access and oversight. Used for internal access (not buyers/sellers). Tracks admin credentials, policy role/authorization, status, and audit fields. Must be strictly separated from business/seller/customer records for compliance and legal defensibility.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email. Used for login and notification. Unique among all administrators.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for login with elevated security (may enforce stricter policy than other roles).

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Administrator's display name for audit and access logs. May not be legal name, but identifies the admin in history.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Administrator account status. Enum: 'active', 'suspended', 'withdrawn', 'banned'. Determines access to system.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Administrator authorization and role level. E.g., 'superadmin', 'reviewer', 'support', as per business policy.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Last login timestamp for tracking admin access activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when account was withdrawn/removed. Null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_products
models.description: All main products listed on the shoppingMallAi platform. Each record represents a base product as provided by a seller, including title, core attributes, pricing baseline, and lifecycle state. Serves as the canonical object for variants, option sets, and is referenced in bundles, category mapping, channel mapping, and snapshot tables. Product state changes are versioned via {@link shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshots}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id}. Owning entity responsible for product management, inventory, and listing compliance.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique product business code as assigned by seller/platform. Used for deduplication, search, and integration with external systems. Must be unique among this seller's products.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Public product name. Required for all products. Displayed in listing and search results.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description (long text, possibly rich content).

plainFields.name: origin
plainFields.description: Product origin (e.g., 'Korea', 'Imported', etc.). For compliance, logistics, and search filtering.

plainFields.name: brand
plainFields.description: Product brand name, if applicable. Supports brand-specific filtering and compliance.

plainFields.name: default_price
plainFields.description: Base price in platform currency for standard configuration of this product.

plainFields.name: published
plainFields.description: Whether the product is currently published (listed and visible to buyers).

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Workflow state of product: 'draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'archived'. Per business rule, governs visibility and modification rights.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Entity creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Most recent update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_variants
models.description: Variants of a product, such as size or color combinations, representing actual sellable SKUs. Connects to main product entry and option sets. Each variant represents a unique physical goods with independent inventory and price override.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}. References the base product this variant is attached to.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Stock Keeping Unit: unique business identifier for this variant.

plainFields.name: option_combination
plainFields.description: Serialized description of option combination (e.g., '{"color":"red","size":"L"}'). For display and uniqueness.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: If populated, this overrides the product's base price for this variant. Null for default variant.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current inventory count for this specific variant/SKU.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Is this variant currently available for sale.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Most recent update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_options
models.description: Defines a possible selectable option for a product variant (e.g., color, size, material). Each option may have type (single, multi, dependency) and allowed values. Linked to a product; used to construct valid option combinations for variant SKUs.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}.

plainFields.name: option_type
plainFields.description: Type of option: 'single' (single select), 'multi' (multi-select), 'dependency' (depends on other option).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Option name (e.g., Color, Size). User-facing label.

plainFields.name: values
plainFields.description: Allowed values (serialized JSON array, e.g., '["Red","Blue","Black"]').

plainFields.name: is_required
plainFields.description: Whether this option is required to select a variant.

plainFields.name: dependency_option_id
plainFields.description: If type=dependency, this points to the dependent option's id, else null.

plainFields.name: display_priority
plainFields.description: Sort/display order in UI.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles
models.description: Product bundles composed of one or more individual products. Managed as a separate product entry with its own price, description, and lifecycle but records bundle linkage separately. Enables sale of product sets with bundle pricing and inventory control.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller's {@link shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business code for the bundle per seller. Enables audit and integration.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Public bundle display name for users.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Full description of bundle contents, logic, and purchase details.

plainFields.name: bundle_price
plainFields.description: Total sale price for the bundle (can differ from sum of items).

plainFields.name: published
plainFields.description: Is the bundle currently displayed and orderable?

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Workflow status: 'draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'archived'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Entity creation date.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion time.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_bundle_items
models.description: Junction table connecting bundles to the component products in each bundle. Stores quantities, item price overrides for bundle context, and the required/optional flag for each included item. Enables accurate validation of inventory/permissible compositions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_bundle_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged bundle's {@link shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Linked product's {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: How many units of this product in the bundle line.

plainFields.name: item_price_override
plainFields.description: If present, overrides item's price in bundle context (else use product/variant price).

plainFields.name: is_optional
plainFields.description: If true, this product is optional in the bundle (can be unchecked by buyer).

plainFields.name: display_priority
plainFields.description: Sort order of this item inside the bundle display.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_carts
models.description: Represents a user's or guest's shopping cart session in the platform. This model tracks all cart sessions, whether assigned to authenticated customers or used anonymously by guests via device/session fingerprint. Designed to support cart merging, abandonment recovery, real-time session validation, and audit for business compliance. Maintains referential integrity to customers (optional), tracks session tokens or device hashes for unauthenticated carts, and holds expiration policy information. Key relationships: optionally references a customer (for logged-in carts), and connects via cart_items to every product selection. Cart merging, concurrency events, and audit flow reference this table for traceability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

Ensures each product+variant occurs only once per cart, supporting atomic item operations and validity audit trails. References the cart, the product, and the product_variant (for option-specific selection). Snapshot fields enable audit of item-level changes. Actively excludes denormalized or calculated values—only core selection data and temporal/audit fields are present. Soft deletion supported for item removal tracking.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_cart_merge_logs
models.description: Full audit trail for events where two shopping carts are merged—typically during customer login (guest-to-customer), account linking, or session restoration scenarios. Tracks both original cart ids, the resulting cart, initiating actor/session, merge rationale, and pre/post merge status for traceability. Supports compliance, customer support, and incident review. Exclusively event/audit log; no calculated fields. All foreign keys required for reconstructing merge lineage and forensics.

plainFields.name: merge_context

### `shopping_mall_ai_sections`

Master table for all store sections/sub-stores within the platform.
Represents logical or branded subdivisions of the shopping mall,
organizing products and categories per business, brand, or special
segment. Critical for multi-store environments, this model establishes
the backbone for product and category mapping, as well as for access
control and customization. Related to [shopping_mall_ai_channels](#shopping_mall_ai_channels)
and [shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories](#shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories) via foreign keys or
mappings.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`
  > Display name of the section/sub-store (e.g., 'Fashion Plaza', 'Brand X
  > Outlet').
- `code`
  > Business-unique, immutable code identifier for the section (e.g.,
  > 'FASHION_PLAZA'). Used for administration, mapping, and reference in
  > other tables. Must be unique across all sections.
- `description`
  > Detailed description and business purpose of the section. Used for
  > administration and display. Optional for some sections.
- `is_active`
  > Whether this section is currently enabled and visible to platform users.
  > Controls store appearance and admin access.
- `display_order`
  > Sort/display priority for front-end listing and backoffice UI. Lower
  > values show earlier; ties broken by name.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of section creation (for auditing and lifecycle management).
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update to section data.
- `deleted_at`
  > Timestamp when the section was (soft) deleted; nullable for active
  > records.

### `shopping_mall_ai_channels`

Master table for business channels (sales, affiliate, event, or
brand-specific), forming top-level logical groupings for catalog and
transaction flows. Channels define eligibility, business rules, region,
or promotional context (e.g., 'Main', 'Mobile', 'Partner_A'). Many
platform processes and products are mapped per channel. Related to {@link
shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories} and {@link
shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_maps}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`
  > Business display name of the channel. Typically used by frontend and
  > admin. Examples: 'Main Channel', 'Mobile Exclusive'.
- `code`
  > Unique channel code. Immutable, used for business process mapping (e.g.,
  > 'MAIN', 'MOBILE', 'PARTNER_A').
- `description`
  > Long-form description or notes for the channel's business scope,
  > restrictions, or target audience.
- `region_code`
  > Optional code for regional segmentation or country grouping (e.g., 'KR',
  > 'US', 'ASIA'). Null if global.
- `is_active`
  > Whether this channel is currently active and available for operations,
  > mapping, or display.
- `display_order`
  > Order in which the channel appears on lists or in backoffice config;
  > lower values have higher priority.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of channel creation.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for this channel/model.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-deletion timestamp if channel is removed from platform offering.

### `shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories`

Master table for categories which exist within the context of a
particular sales channel. Enables per-channel category definitions,
business policies, and display layouts. This decouples global categories
from channel-specific ones, allowing for localized or customized category
trees. Used throughout admin and front system for navigation, search, and
product mapping. Mapped via {@link
shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_maps}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`
  > Parent channel's [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels). Category only
  > visible in this channel context.
- `name`
  > Human-friendly display name for the category as presented in this channel
  > context.
- `code`
  > Unique code for this category in the channel context. Used for mapping,
  > lookup, and business rules.
- `parent_id`
  > (Nullable) Self-reference for hierarchical category trees. Null if root.
  > Points to [shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories).
- `display_order`
  > Sort/display priority in category trees/tabs/menus within a channel.
  > Lower = higher up.
- `description`
  > Optional long-form text describing the category, policy, or intended
  > product domain.
- `is_active`
  > Whether this category is active in platform navigation and product
  > assignment.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for tracking and audit.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for data lifecycle management.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion marker for business-side purging or audit only.

### `shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_maps`

Junction table mapping channel-specific categories to global categories
in the system (which exist in another component as
shopping_mall_ai_categories). This enables complex mapping of platform-,
channel-, or locale-level category trees, while maintaining independence
from global changes. Maintains referential integrity to both local
(channel category) and global category models. Used heavily in admin
mapping workflows and in search/category navigation. No business
fields—purely mapping.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_category_id`: Target channel category's [shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channel_categories).
- `shopping_mall_ai_category_id`
  > Target global category's [shopping_mall_ai_categories.id](#shopping_mall_ai_categories) (external
  > component - foreign reference only).
- `created_at`
  > Creation timestamp of this mapping (for auditing/ref, not for business
  > display).

### `shopping_mall_ai_configurations`

System-level configuration and master option codes table. Stores
key-value pairs and hierarchical configuration settings for cross-domain
control. Used for toggles (e.g., feature flags), system-wide limits,
business rules, or display texts. Central authority for all reference
options (not business domain data). Keys are unique per component-scope
(e.g., SYSTEM, PRODUCT, ORDER).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `scope`
  > Type or functional domain of the configuration (e.g., 'SYSTEM',
  > 'PRODUCT', 'ORDER', 'CHANNEL', application area, etc.). Used for grouping
  > config sets and enforcing option scoping. Must be indexed for fast
  > scoping lookup.
- `key`
  > Config option code (e.g., 'DEFAULT_CURRENCY', 'INVITE_ENABLED'). Unique
  > per scope. Drives feature flags, master data, or parameter assignment.
- `value`
  > String-encoded configuration value. Holds the effective parameter,
  > toggle, or default for the option context. Decoded by services/UI per
  > config key type.
- `description`
  > Optional description of the configuration item—business logic, impact,
  > range of values, or operational notes.
- `is_active`
  > Whether this option is currently active. Used to phase in/out major
  > config elements or setup automated rules.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for config/audit purposes.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp in config lifecycle.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if config is logically removed from live scope.

### `shopping_mall_ai_customers`

Represents individual customers registered on the shoppingMallAi
platform. This model tracks customer-specific credentials, contact
information, verification status, authentication details, and account
lifecycle (active, suspended, withdrawn). It supports the full customer
registration, authentication, profile management, and permission
enforcement lifecycle. Directly subject to strict business and legal
compliance for identity information. No overlap with seller or
administrator information.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Customer's email address. Used for login, notification, and unique
  > identity enforcement. Must be unique among all customers and verified
  > during registration. Business rule: cannot be null.
- `mobile`
  > Customer's mobile phone number. Used for account recovery, 2FA, and
  > notifications. May be required for certain operations. Business rule:
  > optional in registration, but required for some features.
- `password_hash`
  > BCrypt or Argon2 encoded password hash for authentication. Only for
  > internal login; not set for OAuth/SSO-only accounts. Never exposed to
  > client applications.
- `oauth_provider`
  > OAuth or SSO provider identifier if registered via external login. Null
  > for local/password accounts.
- `provider_account_id`: External provider's account ID, if any. Null for password-auth accounts.
- `nickname`
  > Customer display nickname or handle. May be changed by user subject to
  > business rules and length/policy constraints.
- `is_email_verified`
  > Whether the customer's email is verified. Used to determine eligibility
  > for most actions beyond browsing.
- `is_mobile_verified`
  > Whether the customer's mobile is verified. Required for certain business
  > actions.
- `status`
  > Customer account status. Enum: 'active', 'pending', 'suspended',
  > 'withdrawn', 'banned'. Business logic controls access per status.
- `last_login_at`: Last successful login timestamp for session and security tracking.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`
  > Timestamp when the account was logically deleted (withdrawn). Null if
  > active.

### `shopping_mall_ai_sellers`

Represents business sellers on the shoppingMallAi platform. Tracks seller
credentials, business registration, account lifecycle, and verification
status. Only unique to sellers, disjoint from customers/administrators.
Includes identity, contact, compliance, and verification workflow
management. Every seller must be approved by an administrator prior to
making transactions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Seller's email address. Used for login, notifications, and identity. Must
  > be unique among sellers.
- `mobile`
  > Seller's mobile or business contact number. Used for
  > authentication/notification. Optional on initial application, may be
  > required for further business actions.
- `display_name`
  > Public display name of the seller's business/channel. May differ from
  > internal legal name.
- `password_hash`: Password hash for login (BCrypt/Argon2). Not set if only using OAuth/SSO.
- `oauth_provider`
  > OAuth or SSO provider name, if registered externally. Null for
  > password-based.
- `provider_account_id`: Provider-side identity value, if OAuth/SSO is used.
- `business_name`
  > Legal company or business name registered for compliance/audit. Required
  > for verification.
- `business_registration_number`
  > Official business registration ID as required by law. Must be unique
  > among all sellers.
- `bank_account_number`
  > Seller's designated bank account for settlements and remittances. May be
  > required only after verification.
- `status`
  > Seller account status. Enum: 'active', 'pending', 'suspended',
  > 'withdrawn', 'banned'. Controls permissions/business actions.
- `is_verified`
  > Whether the seller has passed admin/kyc verification and is permitted to
  > transact.
- `verification_requested_at`: Timestamp when seller requested verification. Aids in SLA enforcement.
- `verified_at`: Timestamp when verification completed. Null until verified.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when seller account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when seller account last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when seller withdrew or was removed. Null if account is active.

### `shopping_mall_ai_administrators`

Platform superusers and operators with system-wide access and oversight.
Used for internal access (not buyers/sellers). Tracks admin credentials,
policy role/authorization, status, and audit fields. Must be strictly
separated from business/seller/customer records for compliance and legal
defensibility.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Administrator email. Used for login and notification. Unique among all
  > administrators.
- `password_hash`
  > Hashed password for login with elevated security (may enforce stricter
  > policy than other roles).
- `display_name`
  > Administrator's display name for audit and access logs. May not be legal
  > name, but identifies the admin in history.
- `status`
  > Administrator account status. Enum: 'active', 'suspended', 'withdrawn',
  > 'banned'. Determines access to system.
- `role`
  > Administrator authorization and role level. E.g., 'superadmin',
  > 'reviewer', 'support', as per business policy.
- `last_login_at`: Last login timestamp for tracking admin access activity.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when administrator account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when administrator account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when account was withdrawn/removed. Null if still active.

### `shopping_mall_ai_products`

All main products listed on the shoppingMallAi platform. Each record
represents a base product as provided by a seller, including title, core
attributes, pricing baseline, and lifecycle state. Serves as the
canonical object for variants, option sets, and is referenced in bundles,
category mapping, channel mapping, and snapshot tables. Product state
changes are versioned via [shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshots](#shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshots).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`
  > Belonged seller's [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers). Owning entity
  > responsible for product management, inventory, and listing compliance.
- `code`
  > Unique product business code as assigned by seller/platform. Used for
  > deduplication, search, and integration with external systems. Must be
  > unique among this seller's products.
- `title`
  > Public product name. Required for all products. Displayed in listing and
  > search results.
- `description`: Detailed product description (long text, possibly rich content).
- `origin`
  > Product origin (e.g., 'Korea', 'Imported', etc.). For compliance,
  > logistics, and search filtering.
- `brand`
  > Product brand name, if applicable. Supports brand-specific filtering and
  > compliance.
- `default_price`
  > Base price in platform currency for standard configuration of this
  > product.
- `published`: Whether the product is currently published (listed and visible to buyers).
- `approval_status`
  > Workflow state of product: 'draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected',
  > 'archived'. Per business rule, governs visibility and modification
  > rights.
- `created_at`: Entity creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Most recent update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if active.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_variants`

Variants of a product, such as size or color combinations, representing
actual sellable SKUs. Connects to main product entry and option sets.
Each variant represents a unique physical goods with independent
inventory and price override.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`
  > Belonged product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products). References the
  > base product this variant is attached to.
- `sku`: Stock Keeping Unit: unique business identifier for this variant.
- `option_combination`
  > Serialized description of option combination (e.g.,
  > '{"color":"red","size":"L"}'). For display and uniqueness.
- `price_override`
  > If populated, this overrides the product's base price for this variant.
  > Null for default variant.
- `stock_quantity`: Current inventory count for this specific variant/SKU.
- `active`: Is this variant currently available for sale.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Most recent update.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_options`

Defines a possible selectable option for a product variant (e.g., color,
size, material). Each option may have type (single, multi, dependency)
and allowed values. Linked to a product; used to construct valid option
combinations for variant SKUs.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Belonged product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `option_type`
  > Type of option: 'single' (single select), 'multi' (multi-select),
  > 'dependency' (depends on other option).
- `name`: Option name (e.g., Color, Size). User-facing label.
- `values`: Allowed values (serialized JSON array, e.g., '["Red","Blue","Black"]').
- `is_required`: Whether this option is required to select a variant.
- `dependency_option_id`: If type=dependency, this points to the dependent option's id, else null.
- `display_priority`: Sort/display order in UI.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, null if active.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles`

Product bundles composed of one or more individual products. Managed as a
separate product entry with its own price, description, and lifecycle but
records bundle linkage separately. Enables sale of product sets with
bundle pricing and inventory control.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: Owning seller's [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers).
- `code`
  > Unique business code for the bundle per seller. Enables audit and
  > integration.
- `title`: Public bundle display name for users.
- `description`: Full description of bundle contents, logic, and purchase details.
- `bundle_price`: Total sale price for the bundle (can differ from sum of items).
- `published`: Is the bundle currently displayed and orderable?
- `approval_status`: Workflow status: 'draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'archived'.
- `created_at`: Entity creation date.
- `updated_at`: Last modification time.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion time.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_bundle_items`

Junction table connecting bundles to the component products in each
bundle. Stores quantities, item price overrides for bundle context, and
the required/optional flag for each included item. Enables accurate
validation of inventory/permissible compositions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_bundle_id`: Belonged bundle's [shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles.id](#shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Linked product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `quantity`: How many units of this product in the bundle line.
- `item_price_override`
  > If present, overrides item's price in bundle context (else use
  > product/variant price).
- `is_optional`
  > If true, this product is optional in the bundle (can be unchecked by
  > buyer).
- `display_priority`: Sort order of this item inside the bundle display.
- `created_at`: Created at timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Updated at timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete flag: null active, else timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshots`

All product modification and state change events are snapshotted here for
historical/audit purposes. Each record reflects state prior to a
significant change, with full field serialization for rollback and audit.
Linked to product.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Target product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `actor_id`
  > Actor's user ID (seller or admin) who initiated the change. FK only to
  > existing users in user tables.
- `snapshot_data`: Serialized JSON object with all product field values at snapshot time.
- `snapshot_reason`
  > Business reason for the snapshot event: e.g., 'price_change', 'approval',
  > 'rollback', 'delete', etc.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of snapshot creation (immutable).

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_category_maps`

Table mapping products to platform-managed categories, supporting 1:N
mapping. Enforces referential integrity, provides denormalized index for
search. Each mapping represents a valid product-category linkage.
Categories are defined in [shopping_mall_ai_categories](#shopping_mall_ai_categories).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Mapped product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `shopping_mall_ai_category_id`: Associated category's [shopping_mall_ai_categories.id](#shopping_mall_ai_categories).
- `display_priority`: Display order when product is in multiple categories.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of creation.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_channel_maps`

Mapping of products to channel entities (cross-storefront, third-party,
or section-level mapping). Supports multiple active mappings per product,
channel, and section with channel-specific overrides. Used for search
filtering, eligibility rules, and UI. Channels defined externally.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Mapped product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Associated channel's [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels).
- `shopping_mall_ai_section_id`: Specific section's [shopping_mall_ai_sections.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sections), if any. Nullable.
- `channel_status`: Status within this channel: 'active', 'pending', 'inactivated'.
- `display_priority`: Ordering in this channel context.
- `created_at`: Creation date of the mapping.
- `updated_at`: Update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, or null if active.

### `shopping_mall_ai_categories`

Hierarchically structured product categories for catalog navigation,
filtering, and compliance. Each record defines a unique category with
parent/child relationship, for both navigation and enforcement of
category-specific constraints.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `parent_id`: Parent category self-reference. Nullable for root categories.
- `code`: Unique category code, required for integration and search.
- `name`
  > Display name used for UI and search. Must be unique within parent
  > category.
- `display_priority`: Sort order for navigation display and business logic.
- `is_active`: Is this category active/visible in UI?
- `created_at`: Timestamp of category definition.
- `updated_at`: Most recent update.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion flag.

### `shopping_mall_ai_carts`

Represents a user's or guest's shopping cart session in the platform.
This model tracks all cart sessions, whether assigned to authenticated
customers or used anonymously by guests via device/session fingerprint.
Designed to support cart merging, abandonment recovery, real-time session
validation, and audit for business compliance. Maintains referential
integrity to customers (optional), tracks session tokens or device hashes
for unauthenticated carts, and holds expiration policy information. Key
relationships: optionally references a customer (for logged-in carts),
and connects via cart_items to every product selection. Cart merging,
concurrency events, and audit flow reference this table for traceability.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`
  > Belonged customer's [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers). Nullable for
  > guest/anonymous carts.
- `device_session_hash`
  > Hashed fingerprint of guest/anonymous browser/device session. For
  > unauthenticated carts. Required when customer is null.
- `status`
  > Cart status such as active, expired, merged, or abandoned. Used to track
  > cart lifecycle state for session and audit. Enforces valid cart state
  > transitions.
- `expired_at`
  > Date and time when this cart session expires due to inactivity. Cart is
  > purged or archived after this time.
- `last_activity_at`
  > Last time the cart was changed or accessed (add/remove item, update
  > quantity, etc.). Used for session management, expiration, and customer
  > engagement analytics.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when cart session was created.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp when cart session was last updated (write lock, merge, edit,
  > etc.).
- `deleted_at`: When set, this cart has been logically deleted (soft delete for audit).

### `shopping_mall_ai_cart_items`

Stores each line item within a shopping cart, representing a selected
product, variant/option, and desired quantity. Ensures each
product+variant occurs only once per cart, supporting atomic item
operations and validity audit trails. References the cart, the product,
and the product_variant (for option-specific selection). Snapshot fields
enable audit of item-level changes. Actively excludes denormalized or
calculated values—only core selection data and temporal/audit fields are
present. Soft deletion supported for item removal tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_cart_id`
  > Parent [shopping_mall_ai_carts.id](#shopping_mall_ai_carts) representing which cart this
  > item belongs to. Not nullable.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Referenced product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_variant_id`
  > Chosen variant's [shopping_mall_ai_product_variants.id](#shopping_mall_ai_product_variants). Optionally
  > set if the product uses variants.
- `quantity`
  > Quantity of this line item in the cart. Must be positive; validated
  > against product stock and business rules at the time of adding/updating.
- `added_at`
  > Timestamp when this cart item was added. Used for auditing and session
  > analytics.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp when this cart item was last updated (quantity change, option
  > change, etc.).
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion marker for this item in the cart (item was removed before
  > checkout or after merge).

### `shopping_mall_ai_cart_merge_logs`

Full audit trail for events where two shopping carts are merged—typically
during customer login (guest-to-customer), account linking, or session
restoration scenarios. Tracks both original cart ids, the resulting cart,
initiating actor/session, merge rationale, and pre/post merge status for
traceability. Supports compliance, customer support, and incident review.
Exclusively event/audit log; no calculated fields. All foreign keys
required for reconstructing merge lineage and forensics.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `source_cart_id`
  > The original cart's [shopping_mall_ai_carts.id](#shopping_mall_ai_carts) that was merged
  > into the target cart. Not nullable.
- `target_cart_id`
  > The cart's [shopping_mall_ai_carts.id](#shopping_mall_ai_carts) that absorded/received the
  > merge from the source cart. Not nullable.
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`
  > Optional customer's [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers) if the merge
  > was triggered by a known authenticated user (e.g., logging in). Nullable
  > for pure session/device-based merges.
- `merge_context`
  > Context or business reason for this cart merge event (e.g.,
  > 'login_guest_to_auth', 'device_restore', 'manual_merge'). Supports audit
  > trail, diagnosis, and behavior analytics.
- `pre_merge_item_count`
  > Count of all items in source cart before merge (for auditing and
  > forensics).
- `post_merge_item_count`: Item count in target cart after the merge operation.
- `merged_at`: UTC timestamp when the merge event was finalized for audit traceability.

### `shopping_mall_ai_orders`

Represents a top-level order transaction, encompassing all items,
financial and fulfillment details. Parent entity for full e-commerce
transaction, linked to customers, suborders, payment, refund, return, and
after-service flows. Tracks core business and legal audit fields. Main
reference for all historical and compliance reporting.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`
  > Belonged customer's [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers). Customer who
  > placed this order.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`
  > Seller's [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers). Seller responsible for
  > fulfillment, if single-seller order.
- `order_code`
  > Business order identifier, globally unique and visible to all
  > stakeholders.
- `status`
  > Current order status (e.g., pending, paid, fulfilled, shipped, delivered,
  > canceled, etc.).
- `total_price`
  > Total order price at point of creation, without breakdown (use items,
  > payments for details).
- `currency`
  > 3-letter ISO currency code (e.g., KRW, USD) indicating transaction
  > currency.
- `shipping_address`: Snapshot of full shipping address used at time of order placement.
- `recipient_name`: Recipient's name as provided for shipping/fulfillment at time of order.
- `recipient_mobile`: Recipient's mobile/contact number for delivery notification.
- `ordered_at`: Strict order commitment (timestamp when order was finalized).
- `paid_at`
  > Timestamp when payment was completed for the order (null if unpaid or
  > canceled).
- `fulfilled_at`: Timestamp when order entered fulfillment process (null if unfulfilled).
- `cancelled_at`
  > Timestamp when order was cancelled (soft-cancel, may remain for audit or
  > after-service).
- `completed_at`
  > Timestamp when order is marked 'completed' (post-delivery, eligible for
  > review/after-service).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last modification timestamp for order record.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft-deletion timestamp, if order is logically deleted (retained for
  > audit/compliance).

### `shopping_mall_ai_order_items`

Line items within an order, each representing a product, variant, or
bundle at the time of purchase. References parent order, product, and
product snapshots for full auditability. Used for fulfillment, refund,
and after-service resolution.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Parent order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Ordered product's [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_variant_id`: Ordered variant's [shopping_mall_ai_product_variants.id](#shopping_mall_ai_product_variants).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshot_id`: Product snapshot ID at time of order for historical accuracy.
- `product_name`: Product name (as at purchase time, for audit/messaging).
- `product_code`: SKU or product code as at purchase, not necessarily active anymore.
- `quantity`: Quantity of this item within the order.
- `unit_price`: Price per unit of this item at time of order (snapshotted).
- `discount_amount`
  > Amount discounted from unit price, item-level (from coupon/promotion, as
  > snapshotted).
- `total_price`
  > Line item total (unit_price * quantity minus per-line discounts,
  > calculated at order time).
- `refund_status`
  > Current refund state for this line item (none, partial, full, pending,
  > rejected).
- `fulfilled_quantity`
  > Units fulfilled from this line; used for split shipments, partial
  > fulfillment.
- `cancelled_quantity`: Units cancelled for this line after order creation.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last modification timestamp for order item record.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft-deletion timestamp, if order item is logically deleted (retained for
  > audit/compliance).

### `shopping_mall_ai_order_suborders`

Suborder instances created for multi-seller or split-fulfillment orders.
References parent order and segmented for each seller or fulfillment
provider. Enables split payments, logistics, and after-service per
suborder.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Parent order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: Fulfillment seller's [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers).
- `suborder_code`
  > Suborder code (unique per parent order), for fulfillment/analytics
  > reference.
- `status`
  > Current suborder status (e.g., pending, processing, shipped, completed,
  > canceled, etc.).
- `fulfillment_address`
  > Specific address or special instructions for split fulfillment (if
  > different from parent).
- `logistics_provider`
  > Logistics or shipping provider for this suborder (snapshotted at
  > fulfillment allocation).
- `tracking_number`: External tracking number for this suborder shipment, if available.
- `fulfilled_at`: Timestamp when suborder entered fulfillment process.
- `shipped_at`: Timestamp when suborder was shipped to customer.
- `delivered_at`: Timestamp when suborder delivery was finalized.
- `cancelled_at`: Timestamp if suborder was cancelled by seller/admin.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last modification timestamp for suborder record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-deletion timestamp for suborder (audit).

### `shopping_mall_ai_order_state_logs`

Immutable, append-only log of all order and suborder state changes.
Captures actor, timestamp, state before/after, and optional comment for
each transition. Key audit tool for legal, compliance, and operational
debugging.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Linked order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_suborder_id`
  > Linked suborder's [shopping_mall_ai_order_suborders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_order_suborders) (for split
  > fulfillment logs), nullable if not split.
- `actor_admin_id`
  > The administrator's ID from [shopping_mall_ai_administrators.id](#shopping_mall_ai_administrators),
  > if transition was by admin.
- `actor_customer_id`
  > The customer's ID from [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers), if
  > customer-initiated state change.
- `actor_seller_id`
  > The seller's ID from [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers), if
  > seller-initiated state change.
- `prev_status`: Order/suborder status before transition.
- `new_status`: Order/suborder status after transition.
- `transition_comment`: Optional comment explaining context/reason for transition.
- `transitioned_at`: Timestamp of transition event (immutable).

### `shopping_mall_ai_payments`

Payment commitment and settlement records for an order or suborder.
Tracks payment method, provider, status, financial breakdowns, and
references to related orders. Used for financial audits and
reconciliation with external processors.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Reference to related order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `payment_code`: Unique payment transaction code assigned by the platform.
- `payment_method`
  > Payment method at transaction (credit card, bank, mobile, deposit,
  > mileage, etc.).
- `payment_provider`
  > External payment processor or gateway name (as reported at time of
  > settlement).
- `amount`: Amount paid in this transaction.
- `currency`: 3-letter ISO currency code (KRW, USD, etc.).
- `status`: Payment status (pending, succeeded, failed, cancelled, etc.).
- `approved_at`: Timestamp when payment was confirmed/approved (if completed).
- `failed_at`: Timestamp of payment failure if failed/cancelled (nullable otherwise).
- `note`: Optional note or technical message for reconciliation/trace.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record modification timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_ai_refunds`

Refund request and transaction records, usually linked to an order or
payment. Includes full financial, actor, and reconciliation context.
Legally critical for chargebacks, compliance, and accounting. Supports
partial and full refund scenarios.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Parent order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `shopping_mall_ai_payment_id`
  > Reference to related payment's [shopping_mall_ai_payments.id](#shopping_mall_ai_payments), if
  > refund is payment-based.
- `refund_code`: Unique refund transaction code, business-visible and externally auditable.
- `refund_status`
  > Status of the refund (requested, approved, rejected, completed, failed,
  > cancelled).
- `requested_amount`: Requested refund amount (may be less than total payment).
- `approved_amount`
  > Approved refund amount (after admin/seller/auto adjustment), nullable
  > until approved.
- `currency`: 3-letter ISO currency code (KRW, USD, etc.).
- `reason`: Requester-provided reason for refund (user/admin entered).
- `processed_at`: Timestamp when refund processing finalized (completed/rejected/failed).
- `created_at`: Refund record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Refund record updated timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_ai_returns`

Return requests for order items/products. Represents customer- or
admin-initiated process for physical or digital return, mapped to orders
and optionally suborders/items. Tracked for full audit/auditability and
downstream refund, exchange, or after-service actions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Related order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_item_id`
  > Specific order item's [shopping_mall_ai_order_items.id](#shopping_mall_ai_order_items) returned
  > (nullable for full order/partial non-itemized return).
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: Customer who initiated return ([shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers)).
- `return_code`: Business-unique code identifying the return event (RMA).
- `return_reason`: Customer/admin stated reason for the return.
- `status`
  > Status of the return (requested, approved, received, refunded, rejected,
  > completed).
- `received_at`: Timestamp when return was physically received (if physical goods).
- `completed_at`
  > Timestamp when return is resolved (refund issued or corrected, as per
  > business flow).
- `created_at`: Return record created time.
- `updated_at`: Return record updated time.

### `shopping_mall_ai_after_service_requests`

After-Service (AS) requests for resolved or unresolved issues with
completed orders or items. Captures repair, exchange, complaint, special
investigation, or arbitration requests initiated by customer or raised by
the system/administrator. References orders, items, and actors for full
compliance, audit, and service workflow.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`
  > Order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders) for which after-service was
  > requested.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_item_id`
  > Order item ([shopping_mall_ai_order_items.id](#shopping_mall_ai_order_items)), if AS applies to a
  > specific item (nullable).
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`
  > Customer's ID ([shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers)) who requested
  > service.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`
  > Seller's ID ([shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers)) responsible for AS if
  > applicable.
- `as_code`: Business-unique code identifying the after-service case.
- `request_type`
  > Nature of AS request (repair, exchange, complaint, investigation,
  > arbitration, etc.).
- `status`
  > Current status of the AS request (requested, in_progress, completed,
  > cancelled, denied, etc.).
- `contact_comment`: Customer-provided message/comment for service.
- `admin_note`: Internal note by admin/operator about case handling.
- `created_at`: AS request record created time.
- `updated_at`: AS request record latest update time.
